sources.decimation: utils/control_rate.apply_control_rate: decimation 2 -> 4 at env.control_hz 30 (60 Hz reference x 2)
sources.targets: the policy's joint targets are held for the 4 substeps (_apply_action rewrites the same _cur_targets); the hand PD torque is recomputed every substep (1/120 s)

mujoco.note: timestep = Isaac substep / 4: the arm drive's stiffness term is explicit in MuJoCo (implicitfast treats kv implicitly), contact solref (8 ms at 1/480, 12 ms at 1/240, sim2sim-tuned) >= 2 dt; hand_actuator=motor: compute the hand PD once per Isaac substep (every 4 MuJoCo steps), hand_pd.py

robot.gravity: disabled on every robot body in Isaac (bake disable_gravity=True, assets.hand_gravity false) -> MuJoCo gravcomp=1 on every robot body

sources.friction: posedex/runs/r321_*/attempts/000/resolved_config.json env.assets.robot_friction / finger_tip_friction; scene_utils.apply_physx_material_properties gives table + object the robot default (0.5); static = dynamic

mujoco.note: MuJoCo takes max() of the two geoms' friction: fingertip geoms get the PhysX pair average (1.5 + 0.5) / 2 = 1.0 so tip-object / tip-table = 1.0 and every other pair 0.5 as in Isaac

contact_mujoco.tuned_by: agent D sim2sim (sim2sim/README.md); A's original solref 0.005 1, solimp 0.95 0.99 0.001 0.5 2, col_tip friction 1.0
contact_mujoco.note: MuJoCo-only choices (no PhysX equivalent): soft-constraint solref / solimp, condim 4 (torsional friction) on fingertip and object geoms to stand in for PhysX patch friction, elliptic cones + impratio 10, multiccd on (several contacts per convex pair). Edit the <default> classes col_robot / col_tip / col_object / col_world of a scene to tune.

isaac_readback: see checks/CHECKS.md and checks/out/isaac_dump.json (joint gains / limits / armature / friction / masses read back from PhysX on GPU 4)
known_gaps: PhysX max joint velocity (arm 3.14 rad/s, hand 10 x gain rad/s) is a solver constraint; MuJoCo has none. mjsim.VelocityClamp (post-step clip, hand joints by default) reproduces the hand limit; do not clip the arm that way (saturated arm drives). Large arm steps (>~0.1 rad, joint4 / joint6) therefore run faster in MuJoCo 3.16 than in Isaac (joint6 0.3 rad step: t90 25-33 ms vs 117 ms); the policy's arm targets move <= 0.15 rad/s, where both agree to < 1 mrad.

PhysX joint friction is static 0.02 / dynamic 0.016 Nm (hand) and sticks hard; MuJoCo frictionloss is one soft value (0.02): hand steady-state errors after a step are 11 vs 19-21 mrad (thumb) / 1.5 vs 10.6 mrad (index DIP), MuJoCo vs Isaac.

hand_actuator=position computes the hand PD at the MuJoCo timestep without the Isaac substep zero-order hold or the real-pass delay n=2; use motor hand actuators (mjsim.load_model(..., hand='motor')) + hand_pd.HandDelayPD for the exact explicit delayed PD (needed for the 'real' evaluation condition, n = 2).

PhysX TGS rigid contacts (8 position iterations, 2 mm contact offset, patch friction) vs MuJoCo soft contacts (condim 4 on tips / objects, elliptic cones, impratio 10): no equivalent; sim2sim (agent D) tuned solref / solimp and the fingertip friction (TUNED_CONTACT) until lift / acquisition / goals / drops / in-hand re-acquisition match Isaac within noise.

PhysX's vertex-limited (64) convex hulls are approximated by qhull TA60 (same incremental idea, not bit-identical); the fingertip pad point is 12.4 mm inside the 64-vertex tip hull (14.0 mm inside the full hull, the env's fingertip_pad_radius).
Table height: Isaac jitters the table centre z by +-1 cm per episode (also in evaluation); the scene uses the nominal 0.38.
